# 5.3 A more complicated media

In our final example, we take nonperiodic media *κ* as shown in the left of Figure 9. The other settings are the same as the previous semilinear case. We also represent the reference solution snapshots in Figure 10 with *α* = 0*.*6. By the relative errors in Figure 11 and Table 3, the similar findings has been observed as in the previous cases. The errors of the numerical solutions is slightly larger compared to the previous examples, but they still converge to the reference solution.
